task.description: Implement PAR-05, PAR-06, PIN-02 in FULL per their validated Step 01 design artefacts. Implement PIN-01 SCOPED ONLY to AC3 (variable_schema validation, resolves against the real existing variable_schemas table), AC4 (pin_overrides application), and AC5 (deterministic ordering of whatever pins are actually produced). PIN-01 AC1 (catalog-version resolution) and AC2 (module-ref resolution) are explicitly OUT OF SCOPE for this batch -- tracked separately as ISS-0672 / GH-306 (AC1: service_catalog has no version/status column; AC2: PLC-01 module catalog does not exist yet). Do NOT attempt AC1/AC2. Per Step 01b validator routing: implement the catalog_entry/module resolution branches only as far as the design doc's explicitly-marked-provisional stopgap queries (see each design's Public Interface section), and for any reference that does not resolve under that degenerate/stopgap reading, return the design's documented error taxonomy values UnresolvedCatalogRef / UnresolvedModuleRef -- never a silent no-op, never a TODO, never a stub that fabricates success. PAR-06 also requires running its Type C migration YAML (templates/specs/par06-instance-projections-event-window.migration.yaml) via the codegen migration tooling to produce the actual .sql migration file, then applying it. PIN-02 touches src/engine/instance.zig at the event-append call site for INSTANCE_STARTED -- implement exactly per the pin-02-pin-set-in-instance-started.md design (pin set recorded durably in the INSTANCE_STARTED event payload). Read .env directly for BPM_DB_URL / BPM_TEST_DB_URL -- do not hardcode ports anywhere; this host remaps db/db_test to non-default ports via a local docker-compose.override.yml.
acceptance_criteria: PAR-05: online partition conversion implemented per design, zig build exits 0
PAR-06: time-bounded reconstruction implemented per design; migration YAML materialized to SQL via codegen tooling and applied to BPM_DB_URL and BPM_TEST_DB_URL

PIN-01: AC3 (variable_schema validation), AC4 (pin_overrides), AC5 (deterministic ordering) implemented; AC1/AC2 explicitly NOT attempted; unresolved catalog/module refs return UnresolvedCatalogRef/UnresolvedModuleRef per design error taxonomy, not a silent no-op or TODO
PIN-02: pin set durably recorded in INSTANCE_STARTED event payload at the src/engine/instance.zig call site, per design
zig build exits 0 with no new warnings
zig build test exits 0 for any unit-level tests colocated with the implementation (integration tests are TEST-DESIGNER/TEST-RUNNER scope, Steps 3-4)
No implementation deviates from the validated Step 01 design artefacts without a documented, justified reason

Any NEW incidental defect found while implementing (not PIN-01 AC1/AC2, already tracked) is filed as its own ISS + GitHub issue and forwarded to the global queue per core-directives.md -- not fixed inline unless it genuinely blocks this step

result.summary: Implemented PAR-05 (online partition conversion, src/db/partition_conversion.zig, full per design), PAR-06 (time-bounded reconstruction: migration 1150 materialized via codegen_migration.py and applied to both BPM_DB_URL and BPM_TEST_DB_URL, Store.append()/Store.reconstructBounded()/reconstruction.zig's reconstructInstance() extended per design), PIN-01 (src/engine/pin_resolver.zig, scoped to AC3/AC4/AC5 only -- AC1/AC2 return UnresolvedCatalogRef/UnresolvedModuleRef per the design's provisional stopgap, never a silent no-op), and PIN-02 (migration 1151 applied to both DBs; InstanceStore.create() in src/engine/instance.zig wired to call PinResolver.resolve() at Step d.5 and serialise pinned_versions[] into the INSTANCE_STARTED payload at Step e). zig build exits 0, zig build check (PI-03: build + scoped zig fmt --check) exits 0, zig build test exits 0 (103/103 steps succeeded, 1071/1135 tests passed, 64 pre-existing skips unrelated to this batch). Targeted integration verification: zig build test-integration-par06 (3/3 pass against real Postgres) and zig build test-integration-event-store (29/29 pass) both green. One design deviation, documented: PIN-01's pin_overrides could not be wired into InstanceStore.create()'s public signature (adding a 5th positional parameter would break ~20+ existing positional call sites across src/ and tests/, out of this handoff's scope) -- passed as null at this call site; PinResolver.resolve()'s AC4 override-application code path is fully implemented and unit-tested independent of this call site's current inability to supply overrides.
